 Follow Monica Barbaro stuns in daring black dress with thigh-high split
 Faye James Mon, November 16, 2026 at 3:44 AM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. HOLLYWOOD, CALIFORNIA - NOVEMBER 15: Monica Barbaro attends the 17th Governors Awards at Dolby Theatre on November 15, 2026 in Hollywood, California. (Photo by Monica Schipper/Getty Images) (Getty Images) Monica Barbaro made a striking entrance at the Governors Awards on Sunday, stepping out in a black gown with an exceptionally daring split.
 The actress , 36, attended the Hollywood celebration on November 15 in a Valentino creation that combined elegant draping with sparkling, lingerie-inspired details.
 With her dark hair worn sleek and loose, Monica let the statement dress take centre stage as she posed for photographs.
 Monica Barbaro attends the 17th Governors Awards (@ Getty Images)

 Monica Barbaro, 36, stuns in daring plunging dress that nearly reaches her waist at GQ party 
 Monica Barbaro's daring black Valentino gown
 The A Complete Unknown star's floor-length dress featured broad shoulder straps and a deeply draped neckline, revealing an embellished black lace bra-style panel beneath.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement A delicate row of sparkling stones traced the panel's curved neckline, while larger jewel-like embellishments added another flash of light.
 The fitted bodice flowed into a long skirt with a dramatic split extending high up her thigh. A glimpse of black lace at the top of the opening echoed the detailing across her neckline.
 Monica is known for her racy red carpet looks (@ Variety via Getty Images)
 Long lengths of fabric swept behind her to create a trailing silhouette, adding movement to the otherwise streamlined design.
 Monica completed the outfit with pointed black heels, sparkling Tiffany earrings and rings, keeping the accessories relatively understated against the embellished bodice.
 Monica Barbaro's sleek hair and glowing makeup
 Her beauty look offered a softer counterpoint to the dramatic dress. Monica wore her brunette hair in a precise centre part, tucked behind her ears to reveal her jewellery.
 Advertisement Advertisement Defined lashes, softly shaded eyes and warm blush brought a polished finish, while a muted rose-brown lip complemented the gown's dark palette.
 Monica attends the GQ Men of the year party 2026 (@ Getty Images)
 The result balanced a daring silhouette with simple styling, allowing the lace, draping and high split to do the talking.
 Monica Barbaro attends Hollywood's Governors Awards
 The 17th Governors Awards took place at the Ray Dolby Ballroom at Ovation Hollywood, bringing together stars from across the film industry.
 This year's honourees included Glenn Close, Ridley Scott and animator Floyd Norman, alongside producers Christine Vachon and Pamela Koffler.
 Monica is familiar with the awards circuit following her Oscar-nominated performance as Joan Baez in A Complete Unknown. She also reached a global audience playing fighter pilot Phoenix in Top Gun: Maverick.
 Monica wore a daring but chic gown for the occasion (@ Variety via Getty Images)
 Monica Barbaro's honest thoughts on red-carpet dressing
 Despite her assured appearance in front of the cameras, Monica has spoken candidly about the difference between event dressing and her everyday wardrobe.
 Advertisement Advertisement In a March interview with PORTER, she explained that she usually gravitates towards jeans, worn-in loafers, sweatshirts and T-shirts.
 She also acknowledged the pressure that comes with being photographed, describing red-carpet appearances as an unusual exercise in presenting herself.
 "It's supposed to be you, but you're also dressed in a way that you don't dress in your life ever."
